COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
D/13 CLCON No.625 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
 The petitioner has brought to the notice of 
the Court that order dated 20.08.2025, 
passed in WPSS No. 813 of 2025, Prem Singh 
Bisht Vs. State of Uttarakhand and others 
has been wilfully disobeyed by the 
respondents. 
 It appears that pursuant to the order 
dated 20.08.2025, an order has already been 
passed. But, it is disputed that the issue 
involved has not been decided. 
 Let a copy of this contempt petition be 
served to the State Counsel within three days, 
who shall get instruction on it.
 List on 12.02.2026.
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 04.12.2025
Sanjay
